title: Settings
overview: This guide covers settings workflows for Provider.

subtasks.title: Account Setting
subtasks.purpose: Maintain the Provider’s personal account details — profile, password, session timeout and 2FA.

steps.title: Open Account Setting
steps.description: Click Settings in the sidebar (Account Setting tab is preselected).

steps.title: Update Profile Fields
steps.description: Update profile fields — Name, Email, Phone, Address.

steps.title: Change Password
steps.description: Change Password — enter current password, new password (twice) and Save.

steps.title: Set Session Timeout
steps.description: Set Session Timeout (minutes of inactivity before auto-logout).

steps.title: Toggle Two-Factor Auth
steps.description: Toggle Two-Factor Authentication and follow the enrolment steps (authenticator app / SMS).

steps.title: Save Settings
steps.description: Click Save to persist the tab. Notes Session Timeout is capped by the practice-wide policy — the value here cannot exceed the practice maximum. Enabling 2FA is strongly recommended and may be enforced by the practice. Provider coverage now spans Dashboard and the full Practice Detail workspace (Practice, Admins, Providers, Caregivers, Patients — RPM & CCM views, System Caregivers, RPM, Schedule & Targets — Daily Schedule / BP / Glucose / Weight, and Import Patients). Sidebar volumes for Patient Management, Care Management, Calendar, Messages and Settings scoped to the Provider role, followed by the Practice Caregiver and System Caregiver role volumes, will be added in subsequent revisions. 9. Practice Caregiver

steps.title: Practice Caregiver — a practice-employed clinician who monitors enrolled patients, runs follow-up queries, coordinates via messaging, and maintains their own account settings. The Practice Caregiver workspace is scoped
steps.description: it exposes patient management, care management, messages, and settings, but does not include Admins, Providers, Inventory, Billing, Calendar, Programs, or Permissions modules. Task 9.1 — Dashboard
